tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The Pretty QR templates: id, name, description and a preview image URL.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Make the QR code file Download makes in the Pretty QR editor: a 2048 px PNG or an SVG. Counts as one QR API request.

tools.name: open_in_editor
tools.description: Save the design to the account of the API key and return a link that opens it in the Pretty QR editor. Counts as one QR API request.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates · Private data: create_qr_code, create_file_upload, open_in_editor · Public sink: create_file_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates · Private data: create_qr_code, create_file_upload, open_in_editor · Public sink: create_file_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
